card-row-detailed.looks: A row of tall light cards: an optional icon, a heading, a short paragraph, a bulleted list, a button, optional extra text and a second button.
card-row-detailed.use: Comparing two to four services or options, each with a list of what it includes.
card-row-detailed.avoid: Cards without lists: use Multi Icn Btn Col Card Grid.

fields.icon: Optional 96px icon at the top left.
fields.heading: The service or option, a few words.
fields.bulletList: A <ul> list of what the service includes.
fields.additionalText: Optional line between the two buttons, e.g. 'or'.
